_comment: Configuration registry for the forge2 code__code__jazz__litellm__dz_debug package. Per the congruency repo's note-for-claude, the .json at the root of the folder holds the configuration for all tools in this set of packaging, and a tool that cannot see this registry throws rather than guessing a default. Registry-gated modules walk UP from their own file to find it. Each module reads ONLY its own `forge2.code__code__jazz__litellm__dz_debug.<module>` section; sections are disjoint and added additively (see congruency/tools/forge_package.py, #410). Set $DZ_DEBUG_CONFIG to a file holding just the `dz_debug` object below to override it.

dz_debug._comment: This IS the ORIGINAL 115-byte forge unit, transcribed from source into data (#200 requirement 4). The original module hardcoded exactly this: `from .logger import debug_decorator, save`, `from .log import Logger`, and `__all__ = ["debug_decorator", "save", "Logger"]`. One `exports` entry per name, in the original's order — which is __all__'s order, and so is behavior. `source` is spelled "module:attr" in full: the module to import (relative to the dz_debug package, or absolute) and the name to lift out of it. Nothing here is defaulted in code: remove `exports` and `import dz_debug` still works, but every touch of the surface raises ConfigError naming this key. NOTE: `.logger` and `.log` are SEPARATE forge rewrite units that have not landed in this package yet, so touching the surface today raises ModuleNotFoundError — exactly what the original raised in the same situation. See THE MISSING SIBLINGS in dz_debug/__init__.py.
